releaseNotes.zh-CN:
- 虚拟位置会平缓地小范围变化，减少位置突然跳动。
- 地图选点时生成的附近 Wi-Fi 信息更加丰富，名称、信号强弱和网络类型更自然。
- 刷新附近 Wi-Fi 时保留用户已有的 Wi-Fi，不再每次都重新生成。
- 改善蓝牙设备搜索结果的兼容性，适配更多手机系统。
- 修复部分系统读取位置和蓝牙搜索结果不完整或不稳定的问题。
releaseNotes.en:
- Virtual locations now move gently within a small area instead of jumping between fixes.
- Nearby Wi-Fi data generated from a map selection now has more varied names, signal levels, and network types.
- Existing user Wi-Fi records are kept when nearby Wi-Fi is refreshed.
- Improved Bluetooth discovery compatibility across more phone systems.
- Fixed incomplete or unstable location and Bluetooth discovery results on some systems.
